purpose: Export the accepted fixed FP32 CNN only after the CNN byte-buffer path has been restricted to the renewed development allocation and PyTorch-to-ONNX parity passes.
training_boundary: Whole-corpus manifest and duplicate analysis establish allocation metadata. Only train, validation, and calibration inputs enter CNN canonical preprocessing, fitting, or reporting; historical_test and release_holdout candidate bytes do not.
publication: Write temporary files, run ONNX checker and ONNX Runtime parity, then publish all three versioned files only if none already exists. Existing artifacts are never overwritten.
release_holdout: Excluded. The exporter trains only cnn-001 development data and compares only committed synthetic fixtures.
